title: Ember AI Joins NextGen Healthcare Marketplace, Bringing Proactive Revenue Integrity to Specialty Practices
summary: Integration with NextGen Enterprise helps healthcare providers improve coding accuracy, prevent denials and recover missed revenue
body_markdown:
*Integration with NextGen Enterprise helps healthcare providers improve coding accuracy, prevent denials and recover missed revenue.*


BURLINGAME, Calif., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --[Ember AI](https://www.embercopilot.ai/) , the AI-powered revenue integrity platform that helps healthcare organizations collect every dollar they've earned, today announced that its integration with NextGen Enterprise is now available through the[NextGen Healthcare Marketplace](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/marketplace/emberai) , helping specialty practices improve coding accuracy, prevent avoidable denials and recover missed revenue without disrupting existing workflows.


Through its integration with NextGen Enterprise, Ember AI analyzes authorized clinical documentation and encounter data to identify potential coding errors, missed charges, documentation gaps and reimbursement risks. By identifying and addressing issues before claims are submitted, practices can reduce preventable denials, improve reimbursement accuracy and alleviate the administrative burden on revenue cycle teams.


"Specialty practices are under tremendous pressure to protect revenue while managing increasingly complex coding requirements, payer policies and administrative workloads," said Charlene Wang, CEO and co-founder of Ember AI. "Our integration with NextGen Enterprise brings proactive revenue integrity directly into practices' existing workflows, helping teams identify issues earlier, recover revenue that might otherwise be lost and spend less time on manual work."


Ember AI also supports practices after claims are submitted, helping revenue cycle teams investigate denials, prepare appeals and identify underpayments that might otherwise go uncollected. This gives practices a more comprehensive approach to revenue integrity, from identifying issues before submission to recovering revenue after the fact.


The NextGen Enterprise integration builds on Ember AI's recently launched[Strategic Partner Program](https://www.embercopilot.ai/post/ember-ai-launches-strategic-partner-program-and-new-oracle-health-integration) , which includes marketplace relationships with athenahealth, ModMed and Veradigm, as well as a new native Oracle Health (Cerner) integration. Ember AI currently processes approximately 16 million healthcare transactions annually across specialty practices, hospitals and health systems.


To learn more about Ember AI's integration with NextGen Enterprise, visit the[NextGen Healthcare Marketplace](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/marketplace/emberai) .


## About Ember AI


Ember AI is the AI-powered revenue integrity platform that helps healthcare organizations collect every dollar they've earned. Built for the unique challenges of specialty healthcare, Ember AI combines AI with proven reimbursement expertise to level the playing field between providers and payers. By analyzing every encounter before the claim goes out the door, Ember AI proactively identifies coding issues, reimbursement risks, payer inconsistencies, and policy and rate opportunities - taking corrective actions that help organizations reduce risk and increase net revenue. Ember AI seamlessly integrates into existing workflows, allowing organizations to move quickly from implementation to measurable results. With cleaner claims, fewer denials, and no more appeal backlogs, Ember AI helps healthcare organizations create a more efficient, scalable revenue cycle, so clinics can focus on patient care.
